name: tx-dryline-corridor
description: Climatological corridor across West Texas where the meteorological dryline most frequently sits. Hand-drawn polygon based on the NWS / SPC climatological dryline distribution; not a forecast of today's dryline position. The dryline marks the boundary where dry continental air meets moist Gulf air and is the engine of West Texas severe-weather events.

properties.name: Climatological dryline corridor
properties.description: Approximate band where the dryline most frequently sets up across the Texas Panhandle, Llano Estacado, and the eastern South Plains. The actual line varies day-to-day and seasonally; this is the 'most common' corridor.
